## Objective

Implement, migrate, adopt, and verify the approved document-centric To-TRD lifecycle through a source-first, exact-destination workflow.

User value: Completed TRDs will be labeled trd_done and handed to implementation planning without making To-TRD track product implementation progress.

### Success outcomes

- To-TRD exposes only draft, trd_done, and retired as current document states.
- New TRDs contain declarative requirements without implementation completion fields.
- Legacy placeholder-only TRDs migrate explicitly and evidence-bearing records fail closed.
- Reusable source, active root, and registered template pass independent checks and match maintained bytes.
- All four root TRDs migrate safely and the redesign TRD reaches trd_done only after current-revision approval.
- Memory Service, Electronics, unrelated dirty work, Git, publication, and deployment state remain unchanged.

## Scope

### In scope

- Implement schema-version-2 document parsing, rendering, lifecycle, CLI, index, and migration behavior in SKILLS-depo/to-trd.
- Replace and broaden source tests, documentation, templates, examples, actions, and metadata across all 14 maintained package files.
- Verify To-Implementation-Plan can inspect draft and trd_done sources without taking over the TRD lifecycle.
- Adopt the verified source package into the active root and registered template only.
- Explicitly migrate all four root TRDs and obtain current approval before changing the redesign TRD to trd_done.
- Produce current requirement, migration, runtime CLI, package parity, catalog, and preservation evidence.

### Out of scope

- Modify the Memory Service or Electronics To-TRD installations.
- Automatically synchronize reusable source into project-local copies.
- Change To-Implementation-Plan or Task lifecycle semantics.
- Migrate an evidence-bearing legacy TRD without a separately reviewed preservation decision.
- Restore, clean, stage, commit, push, publish, deploy, delete, or otherwise alter unrelated dirty-worktree state.
- Add runtime dependencies, services, databases, network calls, or background processes.

### Execution authority

This plan records and tracks proposed work only. Creating or approving it does not authorize implementation, installation, TRD migration, Git activity, publication, deployment, deletion, or another separately governed action; execution requires a separate explicit request for the exact plan.

### Constraints

- Plan creation and tracking do not authorize implementation, migration, installation, Git mutation, publication, deployment, deletion, or external action.
- Patch the current live dirty files; do not restore target files from Git history or overwrite unrelated user changes.
- Implement in reusable source first, verify it, then adopt only into the active root and registered template.
- Do not modify the Memory Service or Electronics To-TRD copies during the initial delivery.
- Keep the helper Python 3.10-plus and standard-library-only.
- Read-only TRD commands must never migrate canonical records.
- Use exact hashes, bounded locks, atomic replacement, truthful partial receipts, and explicit recovery.
- The approved source TRD remains legacy draft until the new helper migrates it and the current migrated revision is approved.
- Use project-local helpers for TRD, plan, and Task mutations; never hand-edit canonical managed state.
- Reinspect unrelated transient payloads at execution start; do not restore, consume, or delete a payload owned by another workflow.
